warmonger.label: Warmonger
warmonger.vibe: Wants to bathe in the blood of his enemies.
warmonger.desc: Values conquered land {fx.land|up} more and shrugs off neighbours' distrust

builder.label: Builder
builder.vibe: Talks of nothing but coal, iron and railways.

paranoid.label: Paranoid
paranoid.vibe: Sleeps with a pistol and trusts no neighbour.
paranoid.desc: Sees every threat as {fx.threat|times} as large

revanchist.label: Revanchist
revanchist.vibe: Has sworn to take back every acre ever lost.

spendthrift.label: Spendthrift
spendthrift.vibe: Wants wine, opera and a new palace every spring.
spendthrift.desc: Wastes {fx.waste|pct} of all gold on the court, and spends the rest freely

reformer.label: Reformer
reformer.vibe: Reads the liberal papers, and agrees with them.
reformer.desc: Reforms cost {fx.reformCost/rules.reform.cost|frac} and calm more unrest

soldier.label: Soldier King
soldier.vibe: Happiest on a horse at the head of a column.
soldier.desc: His armies fight {fx.fight|harder} but lose {fx.bleed|times} as many men

cautious.label: Cautious
cautious.vibe: Never risks a man he cannot spare.
cautious.desc: Loses ground less often in war, and gains it less often

arbiter.label: Arbiter
arbiter.vibe: Loves a conference more than a battle.
arbiter.desc: Values alliances {fx.allies|x} and is paid to broker peace between his neighbours

shrewd.label: Shrewd
shrewd.desc: Sees his odds in war exactly as they are

admirer.label: Admirer
admirer.vibe: Dresses, dines and thinks like a foreign court.
admirer.desc: Close friend of {friend}, and joins every war it fights

tolerant.label: Tolerant
tolerant.vibe: Sees no difference between his peoples.
tolerant.desc: Accepts the {culture} people as his own, for good: their provinces calm down

chauvinist.label: Chauvinist
chauvinist.vibe: Thinks only his own people are fit to rule.
chauvinist.desc: Provinces of his own people pay {fx.ownPeople|up} more; stops accepting the {culture}, for good

miser.label: Miser
miser.vibe: Counts the candles in the palace.
miser.desc: Values gold {temper.thrift|thrift|times} over: the hoard grows, little gets built

dynast.label: Dynast
dynast.desc: Plans {fx.horizon} years ahead and borrows to build factories

bold.label: Bold
bold.vibe: A gambler at cards, in love and in war.
bold.desc: Plans only {temper.pat|horizon} years ahead and thinks he will win every war

drunk.label: Drunkard
drunk.desc: Misjudges his odds in war, differently every season

mad.label: Mad
mad.vibe: Talks to the portraits in the gallery.
mad.desc: Takes on a new quirk every few years{mood}

lecher.label: Lecher
lecher.vibe: Has a mistress in every palace in Europe.
lecher.desc: Charms every neighbour, but his bastards fight for the throne when he dies

child.label: Child King
child.vibe: Six years old, and already bored.
child.desc: A regent with a random quirk rules until he comes of age; then anything can happen{mood}

incompetent.label: Incompetent
incompetent.vibe: Cannot tell a map from a menu.

usurper.label: Usurper
usurper.vibe: Seized the throne with the army behind him.
usurper.desc: Unrest everywhere until he wins a war

conqueror.label: Conqueror
conqueror.vibe: Means to redraw the map of Europe.
conqueror.desc: His armies fight {fx.fight|harder}; every neighbour distrusts him, and his death brings civil war

genius.label: Genius
genius.vibe: Speaks nine languages and designs his own engines.
genius.desc: Factories cost {fx.factoryCost|frac} and go up {rules.build.factory/fx.buildTime|times} as fast; he leaves no heir, so a council rules after him

architect.label: Great Builder
architect.desc: Raises {landmark}; leaves no gold behind when he dies

liberator.label: Liberator
liberator.vibe: Would free every serf and every people.
liberator.desc: Accepts every people of the realm, for good; the nobles plot a coup

saint.label: Saint
saint.vibe: Prays for his enemies, and means it.
saint.desc: No unrest while he lives, but he starts no wars and helps no ally

iron.label: Iron King
iron.desc: Crushes uprisings and integrates conquests {fx.integrate|times} as fast; when he dies, his subject peoples rise

navigator.label: Navigator
navigator.vibe: Happier on a quarterdeck than a throne.
navigator.desc: Sea trade pays {fx.trade|times} and invading across the sea is easy, but the fleet {fx.upkeep|xs} army upkeep

chancellor.label: Iron Chancellor
chancellor.vibe: Decides the great questions of the day by blood and iron.
chancellor.desc: Raises a great army that fights {fx.fight|times} as hard, one enemy at a time, and keeps all the land he wins. When he dies, his conquests rise

destiny.label: Man of Destiny
destiny.vibe: Has never lost a battle he chose to fight.
destiny.desc: Raises a great army that fights {fx.fight|times} as hard and keeps all the land it wins. When he dies, his conquests rise

prophet.label: Prophet
prophet.vibe: Thousands follow him wherever he rides.
prophet.desc: Raises a great army that fights {fx.fight|times} as hard, and every people he conquers becomes his own at once. When he dies, they are foreigners again

sun.label: Sun King
sun.vibe: The age will be named after him.
sun.desc: The whole nation earns {fx.earns|up} more while he lives. When he dies, the bill comes: {fx.debtYears|word} years of gold a year in debt
